camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyWebCCRule --region cn-hangzhou --Act close --Mode prefix --Count 3 --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Ttl 60 --Uri '/abc' --Name testrule --Interval 30
description_en: Modifies a custom rule for website business frequency control protection (HTTP flood protection)
description_zh: 编辑网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的自定义规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-cc-rule --domain www.aliyun.com --name testrule --act close --count 3 --interval 30 --biz-mode prefix --ttl 60 --uri /abc --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebCCRule

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in the Resource Management product. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website business.

The domain name must have a configured website business forwarding rule. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The blocking type. Valid values:

close: block

captcha: bot detection
parameters.help_zh:
阻断类型。取值：
close：封禁
captcha：人机识别
parameters.name: act

parameters.help_en: The number of access attempts from a single IP address. Valid values: 2 to 2000
parameters.help_zh: 单一IP访问次数。取值范围：2~2000
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en: The detection duration. Valid values: 5 to 10800. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 检测时长。取值范围：5~10800，单位：秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The matching pattern. Valid values:

prefix: prefix match

match: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
匹配模式。取值：
prefix：前缀匹配
match：完全匹配
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The blocking duration. Valid values: 60 to 86400. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 封禁时长。取值范围：60~86400，单位：秒
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The detection path.

The URI cannot be modified. A rule is uniquely identified by the domain name of the website business, the detection path, and the rule name
parameters.help_zh:
检测路径。
URI不支持修改。网站业务的域名，检测路径，规则名称唯一确定一条规则
parameters.name: uri
